Done. The plan at `out/T3/plan.yaml` passed on its first and only execution.

What the plan does, in order:
- Asserts the 48 buffer names match, then deletes them.
- Casts every remaining tensor to float32 in place.
- Asserts the projection-matrix pattern matches 64 tensors, then casts those to bfloat16.
- Runs the required checks as one `assert: all` block: 64 matches all bfloat16, the complementary pattern has 132 matches all float32, layer 0 query_key_value is bfloat16, embed_in is float32, no buffers remain, and 196 tensors total.
- Writes sharded safetensors to `out/T3` with a 256MB shard budget.

Output verified from the file headers: 196 index entries, 64 BF16 and 132 F32 tensors, 9 shards. The two float32 embeddings sit alone in shards 1 and 2. All other shards stay under 256 MiB of tensor data.

The self-report is written to `out/T3/REPORT.md`. One note recorded there: the task text quotes the embeddings at 206 MB, which is their float16 size. After upcasting they are 412 MB each, which still forces the single-tensor shards the task expects.
